verdict.rationale: Baseten documents and hosts an official MCP server (docs.baseten.co/agent-setup, docs.baseten.co/mcp) that lets coding agents manage the Baseten workspace and search docs, and a live probe confirms the endpoint responds to MCP initialize with valid JSON-RPC capabilities. missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation of the MCP server beyond the vendor's own probe, and more detail on the full tool surface exposed.
